name: Shelah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Judah promised Tamar to Shelah and did not perform it. When she saw Shelah was grown and she was not given to him, she put off her widow's garments, covered herself with a vail, and sat where Judah would pass.
She sent Judah his own signet, bracelets and staff, and he acknowledged them: she hath been more righteous than I, because I gave her not to Shelah.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Then she produced the signet, bracelets, and staff, and Judah acknowledged them: She hath been more righteous than I, because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
The sons of Judah are named: Er, Onan, and Shelah, born to him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess, and then Perez and Zerah, born to him of Tamar his daughter-in-law.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah

points: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah are named, with the families that wrought fine linen and the potters that dwelt with the king for his work.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 4: The Families of Judah and Simeon
